stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard reattach [-h] [--all-detached] [--replace]
                                  [--session SESSION] [--workspace WORKSPACE]
                                  [--repo REPO]
                                  [name]

positional arguments:
  name                  The agent's fleet name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --all-detached        Every agent the daemon found detached or dead
  --replace             Also replace a pane that runs the agent but with the
                        wrong account or repo (same guards: not working, alone
                        in its tab)
  --session SESSION     Its OpenCode session id (default: the one the
                        switchboard last saw)
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        The herdr workspace for the new tab (default: where it
                        last ran)
  --repo REPO           Refused when it differs from the session's stored repo
                        (a reattach keeps the stored identity)
